description: Revision ladder L2 as DATA (not a render): render-ready before/after delta so the CLIENT visualizes it. Two modes — VERSION: {scenario_id, version_a, version_b} returns per-geo/candidate/level rows (before, after,…

campaign_id_a.description: Optional campaign custody for A when the model belongs to multiple readable campaigns. Does not grant access.

campaign_id_b.description: Optional campaign custody for B when the model belongs to multiple readable campaigns. Does not grant access.

expected_hash_a.description: Optional expected immutable version hash for A; mismatches refuse.

expected_hash_b.description: Optional expected immutable version hash for B; mismatches refuse.

grain.description: Two-sim canonical outcome rows (margin_a, margin_b, delta_pp, winners, ballots, flipped); uses exact saved version_a/version_b, or latest matching saved heads. Without grain, retains the input-difference ladder.

level.description: Two-sim mode: office/level to tally (e.g. president, senate, house, governor).

limit.description: Maximum geo/candidate rows per page (default 500, maximum 2000); candidate totals and full counts are not paged.

offset.description: Continue with geo_page.next_offset; restart at zero if either live model context changes.

scenario_id.description: Version mode: the scenario whose two versions to compare.

state.description: With grain in two-sim mode, one explicit state postal code or FIPS.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: revision_ladder
